title: Arthur Duke Yonge
dates: (11 June 1820-1909)
---

cousin of CMY

Son of the Rev.

Duke Yonge, Vicar of Antony, he married (1870) Lucy Williams (d.1879).

He was educated at Exeter College, Oxford, became a landscape artist, had one daughter Alethea Yonge (b.

Italy 1870/1).

He may have become a Roman Catholic like his brother John. [Alumni Oxonienses, Coleridge, Life 69]
